text: We did take a bit of a detour on the way

I shouldn't say more. Exploring ruins?
Well, I presume Professor Fig has his
reasons for keeping the details to
himself for now. Yeah. Hello. Uh, speak

with a solid foundation in the basics of

credit there, Professor. They have a
rare aptitude for magic, it seems. Happy
to. But how are you? You both arrived in
perfectly good boats and carriages to

path of a dragon. I wouldn't say I chose
